zh: 优化内置工具备份策略：引入历史备份自动轮转机制，限制保留最近 20 批次，防止快照持续占用磁盘空间。
规范代码目录与调试脚本归档：将散落的一次性排障脚本归档至 scripts/oneoff/，完善运行时诊断与报告输出的忽略规则。
更新客户端发布源与仓库配置：统一修正包描述文件与绿色版更新地址为 Dragon-Platform，保障发行通道一致性。
en: Optimized built-in tools backup strategy: added automatic backup batch rotation, retaining the newest 20 batches to save disk space.
Organized codebase structure and archived debugging scripts: moved one-off scripts to scripts/oneoff/ and refined ignore rules.
Updated client release sources and repository configuration: aligned package repository and portable updater URLs to Dragon-Platform.
